question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.

The play was shortened by the _________ of two scenes.
solution:
The correct answer is '**omission**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**omission**" means something that has been left out or excluded. (चूक या छोड़ देना)
 
• In the context of the sentence, the play was shortened by leaving out (omitting) two scenes.
 
• The other options: "**addition**," "**ommsion**," and "**insirtion**" are either incorrect or do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The play was shortened by the omission__ of two scenes.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Addition (जोड़ना)**: means including or adding something extra.
 
• **Ommsion (Incorrect Spelling)**: is not the correct spelling of "omission."
 
• **Insirtion (Incorrect Spelling)**: is not the correct spelling of "insertion."
